description: Cancel a Quote Link so the customer can no longer approve it: the customer link then says the quote was cancelled. A cancel cannot be undone. The answers and versions so far are kept. Needs the quote's manage_token (the code after # in the private link https://www.workeey.com/q/m/#…; the whole private link is accepted too).

manage_token.description: The quote's private manage token: the long code after # in the private link (https://www.workeey.com/q/m/#<token>), returned as manage_token when the quote is created. The whole private link is accepted too. Required, unless your MCP client already sends it as an Authorization: Bearer header.
